messages:
maria: Heads up — image scan on the private runtime base image flagged CVE-2024-9999 in libfoo. We should coordinate a rebuild + gated deploy. Who owns the rebuild & KMS signing flow?

sam: I can take the rebuild. question: do we want the new image to be signed with our rotating KMS key or keep current cosign key?

ana: @sam we moved to KMS-wrapped signing for private images last quarter. Signing should use the onboarding KMS key with the new key policy. Need an access list for who can trigger sign+promote.

lee: we also need RBAC on the image promotion job — only infra-release and sec-release groups. otherwise anyone with write to the registry can promote.

maria: agreed. action items: rebuild, run scans, sign with KMS, gated promote behind RBAC, update audit logs to capture who triggered promote.

sam: plan: 1) bump base image, 2) run e2e smoke on staging, 3) push to staging repo, 4) sign via cosign KMS plugin, 5) canary-promote using release job.

sam: sample sign command I’ll use:
```
COSIGN_PASSWORD=redacted \
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 \
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/imageSign \
  gcr.io/private/runtime-base:v2.1.3
```

security-bot: NOTE: Signing with KMS key imageSign requires EKM access. Ensure IAM binding "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner" assigned to infra-service-account.

ana: IAM check: infra-service-account currently has signer on key imageSign, but we need to add a granting for sec-release group to trigger promotion jobs. I'll open a ticket.

lee: RBAC change proposal: create a k8s RoleBinding in ci-release namespace that binds group:sec-release and group:infra-release to the job-runner role. Also add a policy for promo-job to only accept signed images.

maria: audit logging: set registry audit retention to 90 days for promote events and keep detailed image manifest logs for 180 days (we may need to comply with legal). Anyone object?

ops-oncall: 90 days SGTM. Need to confirm log export to our central ELK and ensure we index promotion triggers. I can add a short ELK mapping to parse cosign annotations.

sam: vulnerability triage: the CVE is low-severity in libfoo but exploitable in edge cases. I'll patch libfoo in the image and add a failing scan gate to block promotion if the same CVE is present.

maria: good. also add a rollback play: if canary fails, auto-deploy previous signed image and post to #incidents with manual approval to re-promote.

lee: quick question on audit: does GCR/Artifact Registry provide who-triggered info for retag/promote? we might need to annotate promotion job with user info for traceability.

ana: artifact registry only shows service-account for automated pushes. we should require the job to include a "triggered_by" label + write that to audit logs. security-bot will validate presence of label.

security-bot: AUTO-CHECK: promotion jobs without label:triggered_by will be rejected by policy:promote-label required. (This can be overridden by sec-release group with 2-approver flow.)

sam: estimated timeline: start rebuild now, smoke tests in ~2h, sign+canary tonight, full promote tomorrow morning if no regressions.

maria: assign owners: sam (rebuild + sign), ana (KMS/IAM changes), lee (RBAC & policy), ops-oncall (logging), maria (overall coord). I'll create a short runbook and a GH issue to track.

sam: noted. I'll post the cosign output and staging scan results here once done. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: I'll also add an incident hook to ping #incidents if canary error rate > 5% during first 30m.

maria: thanks all — please update the GH issue and link the ticket here so we have audit trail.

devops-bot: Created issue infra/2314 "rebuild-runtime-base - CVE-2024-9999" and added owners: sam, ana, lee, ops-oncall, maria. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/2314

sam: got it, starting now.

maria: tag me if you need emergency rollback.

lee: FYI I'll open the RBAC PR after IAM ticket from ana lands.

ana: IAM ticket: created, request id KMS-783. CCing security for review.

maria: perfect. wrap-up: rebuild in progress, KMS signing will be used, RBAC gating and audit label required, ELK export on, rollback and incident hooks added. I'll follow up in the issue. :white_check_mark:
